name: FinChain Dollar
oneLiner: FUSD is FinChain's BMA-licensed, rebasing dollar stablecoin backed by tokenized U.S. Treasury bills and money-market funds.
collateral: Tokenized U.S. Treasury bills and money-market funds, including Taikang Kaitai U.S. Dollar Money Market Fund, ChinaAMC USD Digital Money Market Fund (Tokenized Unlisted Class), and BNY Mellon U.S. Dollar Liquidity Fund
pegMechanism: Eligible customers mint and redeem through FinChain; FUSD targets a fixed $1 token value while balances rebase daily to distribute reserve yield from the underlying tokenized Treasury and money-market fund portfolio

proofOfReserves.provider: FinChain reserve dashboard (reserve section is captioned 'as of February 2026' and figures do not render statically - no live feed observed as of 2026-08-08)

applicabilityBasis.summary: FUSD has issuer-style 1:1 minting and reserves, but it is natively yield-bearing and backed by tokenized T-bills/MMFs; the GENIUS Act's payment stablecoin definition may exclude yield-bearing/rebasing instruments, leaving applicability genuinely unresolved.

genius.licensingRegulator: Bermuda Monetary Authority (digital asset business license)
genius.notes: FUSD is stablecoin-adjacent, but yield-bearing reserve-token mechanics make GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved. Issuer is FinChain Bermuda Limited (a separate accounts company / SAC), a wholly owned subsidiary of FinChain Holdings (Cayman) Limited, itself backed by Fosun Wealth Holdings. BMA digital asset business license confirmed. No US authorization pathway initiated as of 2026-06-18.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for FUSD or FinChain Bermuda Limited. Issuer holds a BMA digital asset business license only.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FinChain Dollar resolves to Yes because metadata classifies the asset as a centralized, licensed issuer stablecoin and the token is issued through issuer-managed deployments.

mintAuthority.summary: FUSD is an uncapped issuer token on Ethereum, Avalanche, Sonic, and Monad. FinChain's gateway can mint directly (including an admin-only arbitrary mint path), while Chainlink CCIP pools mint only through validated inbound routes and per-chain rate limits. One EOA controls every token DEFAULT_ADMIN role, the gateway admin, the configurable pools, and the shared ProxyAdmin owner, so it can grant minters or replace mint logic immediately.

controls.label: FinChain issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: FinChain documents eligible-customer issuance and redemption through its centralized operating stack. The backend controls an uncapped gateway/admin path and the token role administrator across all four chains, so it can originate additional issuance rather than merely consume a fixed allowance.

controls.label: FinChain token, gateway, pool, and ProxyAdmin owner EOA

sources.label: Ethereum FUSD verified proxy and implementation

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712369, Avalanche 92345390, Sonic 77265782, and Monad 94291746 this codeless address is the sole token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and owns the shared ProxyAdmin. It also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the FinChain gateway and controls the active issuer-owned CCIP pools. It can grant token MINTER_ROLE, invoke the gateway's arbitrary direct mint, reconfigure route limits, or upgrade every proxy without a timelock.

controls.label: FUSD FinChain mint proxy (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: This same-address gateway is a live token MINTER_ROLE holder on all four chains. Verified FUSDGateway logic requires KYC plus FUSDLP transfer for public instantMint, but also exposes an arbitrary amount mint to its DEFAULT_ADMIN and mintWithMessageId to an internal MINTER_ROLE; it therefore has direct uncapped token mint ability. Its own logic does not administer the token role or cap.

controls.label: FUSD TokenBridgeSender (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: The same-address proxy remains a token MINTER_ROLE holder on all four chains, but its current verified TokenBridgeSender implementation only transfers/burns already supplied bridge tokens through supported custom or CCIP destinations and contains no call to FUSD.mint. It cannot exercise the nominal mint role without a proxy upgrade, which is captured by the shared ProxyAdmin control.

controls.label: FUSD CCIP BurnMintTokenPool-1 (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: This verified FUSDBurnMintTokenPool can mint only through Chainlink CCIP releaseOrMint after TokenPool validates the router, remote pool/token, RMN state, allowlist, and inbound rate limiter. Its owner can reconfigure route rate limits; supportedChains was empty at the pinned block, so it is presently an authorized but inactive mint route.

controls.label: FUSD CCIP BurnMintTokenPool-2 (MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: This verified FUSDBurnMintTokenPool mints only after Chainlink CCIP releaseOrMint validates the router, configured remote pool/token, RMN state, allowlist, and inbound rate limiter. It served three configured selectors at the pinned block, and owner 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215 can raise route limits.

controls.label: FUSD Avalanche CCIP BurnMintTokenPool (Chainlink-owned)
controls.evidence: Live Avalanche MINTER_ROLE holder. Its owner is contract 0x914d7fec6aac8cd542e72bca78b30650d45643d7 and its runtime family matches the reviewed Chainlink FUSDBurnMintTokenPool route, which mints only through validated inbound CCIP messages and configurable rate limits.

controls.label: FUSD Avalanche CCIP BurnMintTokenPool (FinChain-owned)
controls.evidence: Live Avalanche MINTER_ROLE holder owned by FinChain EOA 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215. The pool mints only through validated inbound CCIP messages and rate limits that its owner can raise.

controls.label: FUSD Sonic CCIP BurnMintTokenPool (Chainlink-owned)
controls.evidence: Live Sonic MINTER_ROLE holder. Its owner is contract 0x914d7fec6aac8cd542e72bca78b30650d45643d7 and its runtime family matches the reviewed CCIP pool, restricting mint to authenticated inbound routes and configurable rate limits.

controls.label: FUSD Sonic CCIP BurnMintTokenPool (FinChain-owned)
controls.evidence: Live Sonic MINTER_ROLE holder owned by FinChain EOA 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215. Mint is restricted to authenticated inbound CCIP routes and configurable rate limits.

controls.label: FUSD Monad CCIP BurnMintTokenPool
controls.evidence: The official Monad RPC confirms this contract is the third live token MINTER_ROLE holder alongside the shared gateway and TokenBridgeSender. It is owned by FinChain EOA 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215 and follows the FUSD CCIP BurnMintTokenPool route model, so mint is inbound-route and rate-limit constrained while its owner can raise limits.

controls.label: FUSD shared ProxyAdmin contract
controls.evidence: This is an OpenZeppelin ProxyAdmin contract, not an EOA. At the pinned blocks it occupies the EIP-1967 admin slot for the token, gateway, and TokenBridgeSender on all four chains, and owner() is the codeless FinChain EOA 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215. It can replace mint-critical logic immediately.

review.evidence: Fresh role enumeration at Ethereum block 25712369, Avalanche 92345390, Sonic 77265782, and Monad 94291746 resolves every live MINTER_ROLE holder and the shared control plane. Each token proxy uses implementation 0x27d2f80fdb8102044897d006c921645c8da92de0 and ProxyAdmin 0x29a48097055d6779e6832355680b7c7bf0d43c53, owned without delay by sole DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA 0xc61f22aa3a6469f4f90994421f4570459217c215. The gateway's verified admin-only mint makes the economic cap unbounded; CCIP pools remain authenticated-route/rate-limit constrained. The previously described TokenBridgeSender mint power was corrected: its current verified implementation never calls FUSD.mint. FinChain's live reserve dashboard is the continuous issuer reconciliation source; no independent dated attestation was found. The BMA register and DAB regime identify FinChain Bermuda Limited as a supervised digital-asset issuer, supporting prudential supervision.
